DECLARE @DOCNUM VARCHAR(30) = '{0}' DECLARE @ROUTYP VARCHAR(30) = '{1}' DECLARE @MFGNUM VARCHAR(30) = '{2}' DECLARE @ROUALT VARCHAR(30) = '{3}' DECLARE @ROUOPE VARCHAR(30) = '{4}' DECLARE @ITMNO VARCHAR(30) = '{5}' DECLARE @USER VARCHAR(30) = '#LOGIN_USER#'
-- 获取工单相关信息 IF @DOCNUM = '' BEGIN DECLARE @CUSCOD VARCHAR(30) = '' DECLARE @INTSPE VARCHAR(30) = ''
SELECT @ROUALT = H.ROUALT_0 , @ITMNO = H.ROUNUM_0 , @CUSCOD = I.BPCNUM_0 , @INTSPE = I.INTSPE_0 FROM #LC.X3DATA#MFGHEAD H INNER JOIN #LC.X3DATA#MFGITM I ON I.MFGNUM_0 = H.MFGNUM_0 AND I.ITMTYP_0 = 1 WHERE H.MFGNUM_0 = @MFGNUM;
-- 拼接产生完整的检验任务单号 SET @DOCNUM = CONCAT_WS('-', @MFGNUM, @ROUOPE)
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM QAINSPH WHERE DOCNUM = @DOCNUM) RETURN;
-- 如果是扫描创建质检任务时，获取工单的ROUALT IF @ROUALT = '' OR @ITMNO = '' BEGIN SELECT @ROUALT = H.ROUALT_0 , @ITMNO = H.ROUNUM_0 FROM #LC.X3DATA#MFGHEAD H WHERE H.MFGNUM_0 = @MFGNUM; END
-- 拼接形成 ROUCOD DECLARE @ROUCOD VARCHAR(30)
SET @ROUCOD = CONCAT_WS('-', @ITMNO, @ROUALT, @ROUOPE)
-- CREATE INSPH INSERT INTO QAINSPH ( DOCNUM , DOCDAT , ROUTYP , ITMNO , MFGNUM , ROUALT , ROUOPE , ROUCOD , CUSCOD , INTSPEC , CREUSR , CRETIM ) VALUES ( @DOCNUM , GETDATE() , 'SFC' , @ITMNO , @MFGNUM , @ROUALT , @ROUOPE , @ROUCOD , @CUSCOD , @INTSPE , @USER --CREUSR , GETDATE() --CRETIM )
-- CREATE INSPL INSERT INTO QAINSPL ( DOCNUM , OPENUM , OPESTD , OPEGRP , OPEUNT , CTLTYP , MEAFRQ , NMIN , NNOR , NMAX , TRXUSER , TRXDAT , CREUSR , CRETIM ) SELECT @DOCNUM , L.OPENUM , L.OPESTD , L.OPEGRP , L.OPEUNT , L.CTLTYP , L.MEAFRQ , L.VALMIN , L.VALNOR , L.VALMAX , @USER TRXUSER , GETDATE() TRXDAT , @USER CREUSR , GETDATE() CRETIM FROM QAROULIN L INNER JOIN QAROU R ON R.ROUCOD = L.ROUCOD WHERE R.ROUCOD = @ROUCOD;
-- 更新 Logic 的控制信息 UPDATE L SET L1CHECK = LC.L1CHECK , L2CHECK = LC.L2CHECK FROM QAINSPL L INNER JOIN ( SELECT T.OPENUM , MAX(IIF(T.VALLIN = 1 AND T.VALDES <> '', 1, 0)) L1CHECK , MAX(IIF(T.VALLIN = 2 AND T.VALDES <> '', 1, 0)) L2CHECK FROM QAROULINCTL T INNER JOIN QAROULIN L ON L.ROUCOD = T.ROUCOD AND L.OPENUM = T.OPENUM WHERE L.ROUCOD = @ROUCOD AND L.CTLTYP = 'L' AND T.VALTYP = 'L' GROUP BY T.OPENUM ) LC ON LC.OPENUM = L.OPENUM WHERE L.DOCNUM = @DOCNUM END
